configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Generator, build dir, and editor ergonomics shared by every way of configuring this superbuild. CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS must be set here, not in CMakeLists.txt: CMake pre-seeds it blank before project code runs, so set(... CACHE ...) there is a no-op.

configurePresets.name: pixi
configurePresets.description: Adds the compiler/linker/build-cache settings pixi sets via ../pixi.toml's [activation.env]. Requires 'pixi run' (only place these env vars are set). Not used by colcon, conda-forge, or per-package wheels.
